logp.method_description: The partition coefficient of 99mTc-1 complex was determined by the shake-flask method as previously reported. In a centrifuge tube, containing 1.5 mL of 1-octanol and 1.5 mL phosphate buffer saline (PBS, 0.1 M, pH 7.4), 50 μL of the 99mTc-1 complex solution was added, and the mixture was vortexed at room temperature for 1 min and finally centrifuged at 5000 rpm for 5 min. The radioactivity of three aliquots (0.1 mL) of both 1-octanol and PBS phases were counted in a γ-counter. A sample (0.5 mL) from the octanol layer was subsequently re-partitioned in octanol (1 mL)/buffer (1.5 mL) until constant values were obtained. The partition coefficient was expressed as the logarithm of the ratio of the counts per gram from n-octanol versus those from PBS (logP(o/w)). The experiment was repeated three times.
